finding: Both resistance denominators are selected: the perineal swabs were optional, and percentages count only participants whose swab yielded E. coli. The sentence should name that denominator for the 6/12-month and 18-month results.
evidence: DOI 10.1136/bmj-2021-068229, p. 6 and Fig. 2: optional perineal swabs yielding E. coli; resistance to at least one antibiotic at 6 or 12 months was 46/64 (72%) antibiotic versus 39/70 (56%) methenamine; multidrug resistance at month 18 was 9/45 (20%) methenamine versus 2/39 (5%) antibiotic.

edit.old: At the 6- or 12-month visits, resistance to at least one antibiotic in *E. coli* from perineal swabs was found in 46/64 antibiotic participants versus 39/70 methenamine participants (72% vs. 56%; p = 0.05); at 18 months, six months after treatment ended, multidrug resistance was found in 9/45 methenamine versus 2/39 antibiotic participants (20% vs. 5%; p = 0.06).
edit.new: Among participants whose optional perineal swabs yielded *E. coli*, resistance to at least one antibiotic at the 6- or 12-month visit was found in 46/64 antibiotic versus 39/70 methenamine participants (72% vs. 56%; p = 0.05); at 18 months, six months after treatment ended, multidrug resistance was found in 9/45 methenamine versus 2/39 antibiotic participants (20% vs. 5%; p = 0.06).<sup>[[24]](#ref24)</sup>
